$comment: Fikirtive brand palette v4 · Founder approved 2026-08-20 · V1 light only. Ratio: neutrals ~90% / gradients ~8% / coral ~2%. Semantic colors signal state only.

brand.$rule: Coral #EC5828 = brand mark color (F tile, Otto cloud). In product UI, coral marks Otto presence only; human-action buttons are ink.

gradients.$rule: 135°, two stops. Content accents only, never page frames. At most two per screen. Text on gradients uses the matching textOn tone at >= 4.5:1.

typography.$rule: 英文 sentence case;数字成列开 tabular figures;中文回退 PingFang SC / Noto Sans SC。
